firm_data.firm_description: Snyder & Snyder, LLP delivers legal services to the companies that make the future possible, providing support for development across private and public sectors and legal solutions to companies that are ready to expand. The firm has represented industry leaders in competitive, large-scale sectors such as telecommunications, healthcare, education, renewable energy, waste management, and big-box retail.

email.subject: AI for Snyder & Snyder, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Leslie,

Snyder & Snyder serves industry leaders across telecommunications, renewable energy, and complex real estate transactions. That means your team regularly faces the same document volume and deadline pressure as BigLaw, but with leaner resources.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms in exactly your position. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your office in Tarrytown to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like yours compete without sacrificing quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
